entries.name: The Sweep
entries.description: Captain Vane has sealed the Seventh Ward grates and the Watch is selling captives for a Bastion commission. Break the sweep at Alleyway Junction 7.

steps.text: Break Vane's sweep at Alleyway Junction 7

entries.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and Vane's gate cipher.

entries.name: The Crossroads Cages
entries.description: Proctor Quell runs an open-air titration pen at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads, and the Flagellants cull the cages by the bell. Free them.

steps.text: Free the cages at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads

entries.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and Quell's retorts for the Slab.

entries.name: The Bone-Mill Raid
entries.description: Overseer Grendel grinds uncremated Spent into bone-mortar at the Fourth Kiln. Wreck the mill and free the chain gang.

steps.text: Wreck the Bone-Mill at the Fourth Kiln

entries.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and a new bunk.
entries.closed_text: Clear the Sweep and the Cages first.

entries.name: The Tallow Vats
entries.description: Guild-Master Orlov brings Render-Beasts and Dredgers to burn out a young chemist at the Tallow Vats. Cut through and find her.

steps.text: Cut through the Tallow Vats and find the chemist

entries.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and Orlov's Retribution; five days of Warded Tallow wait in Orlov's stores.
entries.closed_text: Clear the Sweep and the Cages first.

entries.name: The Drowned Sluice
entries.description: Inquisitor-Prelate Nemeth holds the Crucible Watchpost and the Slag Gate behind it. Open the gate. One of you holds the winch.

steps.text: Hold the Crucible and open the Slag Gate

entries.reward: Talia's thanks. The Bastion waits beyond the gate.

set.description: Hollis dropped the Crucible's outer counterweight and the gate's reinforcements will arrive a round late. Open the Slag Gate. One of you holds the winch.

entries.closed_text: Something under the Undercroft must be answered first.

entries.name: Corvo's Gate
entries.description: Bailiff Corvo keeps the Third Ward gate. Settle the toll with Scrap or Rock Salt, or break it open and risk his sister Ida.

steps.text: Settle the toll at the Third Ward gate

entries.reward: Talia's thanks, and either a quiet gate or a loud one.

entries.name: The Night of the Red Pen
entries.description: Talia's courier Ivo, twelve, is chalked into the Seventh Ward Toll-Pen at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads. Take him out before the Tithing clock runs down.

steps.text: Bring Ivo out of the Toll-Pen

entries.reward: Talia's thanks, and Widow Varka's shelves.

entries.name: The Seventh Ward Bellows
entries.description: Kaelen's old Watch armory cache lies beneath Alleyway Junction 7, with a bellows nobody was told to burn. Take it, and a plate Berek can rework.

steps.text: Raid the old Watch armory cache at Alleyway Junction 7

entries.reward: Slag Plating, and cheaper coals at Berek's Hearth.

entries.name: The Sluice Lock-Ciphers
entries.description: Vesper knows the flood-lock tablets under the Drowned Runoff Grate. Map them and the drains give the cell a quiet road of its own.

steps.text: Map the forgotten flood-locks at the Drowned Runoff Grate

entries.reward: A permanent Siphon Shortcut with no Alert on the road.

entries.name: Liturgical Cipher Rubbings
entries.description: Maren will decode the cage-seal rubbings from the Crossroads. Take them to St. Lyra's hidden reliquary flue.

steps.text: Take the cage-seal rubbings at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads

entries.reward: Maren's clue to St. Lyra's flue, for Act 2.

entries.name: The Crag-Sight Overlook
entries.description: Hollis wants the chimney sightlines above the Crucible and the outer counterweight cut. The Prelate's reinforcements arrive a round late.

steps.text: Secure the Crag-Sight Overlook above the Crucible

entries.reward: Hollis's Lever-Winch, and a gate wave that arrives a round late.
entries.closed_text: Something under the Undercroft must be answered first.

entries.name: Chain-Gang Wedges
entries.description: Dunstan will pull the black-iron wedges from the ruined mill. Skerrit, Bone-Wright wants them.

steps.text: Pull the black-iron wedges from the Fourth Kiln

entries.reward: Rock Salt, and Skerrit's bone-shard recipes.
entries.closed_text: Free the Bone-Mill's chain gang first.

entries.name: The Tenement Counter-Still
entries.description: Elyse will check her awakened mother's tenement block and distil tallow. The Vats' leftover stills are hot.

steps.text: Check the counter-still at the Tallow Vats

entries.closed_text: Cut through the Tallow Vats first.
